actual_reviewer_identity.host_role: Codex reviewer; exact model/effort not attested

supported_scope: Local source-only inspection of isolated Nr3D/Sr3D preparation, exact native-source comparison and synthetic checker/runner review. No accuracy or deployment acceptance.

findings.title: Nr/Sr evaluation and retained-best contract is still hard-coded to ScanRefer
findings.evidence: evaluate_one_epoch asserts [9508, 9508] and returns rows=9508; record_native_metrics separately asserts rows==9508. Fresh main() evaluates E0 before any epoch. native_metric_order retains absolute ScanRefer hit gates 5658/4850.
findings.impact: A native split with a different actual row count aborts at E0. Removing only that assertion leaves incorrect denominator reporting/recording and ScanRefer-dependent best-checkpoint ordering.
findings.recommendation: Use the actual complete Nr/Sr validation denominator in both evaluation and recording, and explicitly define the intended native REC best-checkpoint order without the ScanRefer hit gates. Keep the native evaluator and bbs scorer unchanged. main_utils.py needs a narrow change; update the intended changed-file list and plan from five to six if that fix is applied.

findings.title: CPU runner omits the already-proven native import environment binding
findings.evidence: The checker imports models.losses before loading prepared helpers. Native models/__init__.py imports PVGround first, and the recorded native import chain reaches pvground_observation_query and pcdet. Archived attempt1 stderr ends in ModuleNotFoundError for pcdet. The successful historical R2 explicitly hydrated env_spec.json env and PYTHONPATH; this new wrapper only inherits ambient os.environ and adds CPU/thread variables.
findings.impact: The proposed CPU execution does not reproduce the known working import binding and can fail before any target/gradient assertion. This is an evidenced dependency issue, not a hypothetical compatibility concern. The new checker has not been executed, so this report does not claim a new observed failure.
findings.recommendation: Reuse the existing audited runtime env/PYTHONPATH hydration before importing the native criterion, then explicitly keep CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty. Preserve the intended original native SetCriterion versus prepared G/C helper comparison. Do not install packages or add fallback imports.

findings.title: Fresh B gate is documented as 0.5 but the unchanged constructor produces 0
findings.evidence: The fresh mixer zeros its output weight and bias, then computes raw_gate.clamp(0,1). Hence its initial gate is 0 and its initial box is the Mask reference; no span checkpoint is loaded.
findings.impact: The documented E0 initialization is inaccurate. It is not evidence that the model starts at a fixed-half mixture or matches the author-only E0.
findings.recommendation: Correct the preparation text to gate 0/full Mask reference if preserving the current architecture, as this task requires. Do not silently modify the mixer to make the prose true.

correct_in_scope: G uses root slot 0, protects every Hungarian matched query, and excludes annotation sample_dataset=scannet; language_dataset controls the native task recipe.

G root target weights match native loss_pos_align: ScanRefer/Nr 0.6/0.2/0.2/0.1 and Sr 0.625/0.125/0.125/0.125. For the intended single-rank six-decoder setup its external coefficients match 0.5/7 and 1/7, preserving the native eos weight and target entropy.

Dataset snapshot creates expression root first, optional first anchor afterwards, and consecutive valid GT slots. Native criterion filters these slots without reordering. This supports the source root/anchor mapping, not observed real-data validation.
C skips matched-root, matched-other and detection rows before assigning any new target; it uses the filtered root mask for only the chosen unmatched query and divides by the whole actual batch.

Current synthetic checker correctly uses allow_unused=True and expects None for the skipped independent matched-other and detection mask leaves in its chosen panel; no residual assertion bug was found in that path.

Checker directly calls actual SetCriterion.loss_pos_align with synthetic tensors and manual indices. Its check is target/gradient engineering, not full native criterion, Hungarian, loader, model or accuracy execution.

Fresh initialization loads the corresponding manifest author core before adding G/A/B; G copies the loaded core fusion/attention pieces, A output is zero, B gate is zero, C has no parameters. ScanRefer G1072/support/span overlay loading is removed.

Nine byte-identical files preserve forward, G readers, A/B modules, mask geometry and root bbs implementation. Native scorer matches the supplied evaluator root-map operations. No new ranking, evaluator replacement, dataset-specific inference gate or fallback was added.
CPU runner retains raw stdout/stderr/exit before its result assertions, uses a separate fixed output directory and disables CUDA visibility; it does not query current training state in its source.
tooling_notes: Initial PATH python failed before executing the stdlib script: No pyvenv.cfg file. This was not a checker run.
Source-only AST then passed via the already-installed uv run --offline python -B -X utf8 interpreter; no installation was performed.
The historical import success/failure records describe a previous source binding; they do not establish present runtime success.
The unrelated dataset_source/utils/scatter_util.py was not read or substituted for the actual PV runtime utility.

Construct each model from its corresponding author checkpoint and verify complete keys/shapes/dtypes, state counts, source values and preserved trainability; strict=True source code alone is insufficient.
Check real single-rank criterion/Hungarian integration, optimizer grouping, normal training steps, full save and cold restore, and true validation denominators.

Fix the final shared architecture, predeclare the independent training budget and best-checkpoint metric, then execute full fair Nr/Sr training and native REC evaluation. No cross-benchmark scientific claim follows from this review.
